strings.sec.seo.lede: Ukulinganisa kwamagama angu-1,200+ angaphakathi kwesikhathi eside leTQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah. Konke igama lidla ngemininingwane edlalene, umgomo wesicelo, amagama ahlala, umkhawulo wokuchaziwe. Yashicilelwe ngesikhathi esinye — iyachaziwe, ishicilelwe, idluliselwa.

strings.sec.contribute.lede: Abantu abaningi bangathumela ulwazi, amathoni, ukubhala, inkampani, amagqabuko, ulwazi lwesizwe, namashusha. Ukuhlanganisa akukho ukushicilela: konke okuthumelwa kuchazwa ngaphambi kokufika kwisishayamithi.
strings.docs.noResults: Akukho igama elinaniwe lelihlobo "{q}". Zama igama elisha — ngokuthi, "sanad", "evidence", "founder".
strings.docs.verbatimBody: Oku uthi bheka lapha kuyigama eliqondile lelicwadi — akukho ukushicilela okungaphelele. Konke licwadi lidla ngakho okuqukethwe kuyo, isikhathi, isimo sokwenziwe; izinketho zenzeka kuphela ngokulondolozisa, akukho ukushicilela ngokusemthethweni.
strings.docs.closingNote: Lezi zicwadi ziyamathoni okuqala konke ukubonakala kwesistemi: isakhiwo somuntu, isistemi yokulinganiswa kwe-A-F, amalungelo e-sanad, namandla okulondolozisa konke okunye okubonakala kuyizalela lapha. Unesishusha okanye ukwandisa okuqukethwe kumagama? Thumela ngokushicilela — konke okuthumelwa kuchazwa, akakashicilelwa ngokusemthethweni.
